title: LiblzmaVendorBuildContract
description: Schema definition for Vendor/liblzma static library build flags and configuration

enable_arm64_crc32.description: Whether ARMv8 ACLE CRC32 hardware instructions are enabled

enable_neon.description: Whether ARM NEON Advanced SIMD vectorization is enabled

output_static_library.description: Path to output static library file (e.g. Vendor/lib/liblzma.a)

mas_sandbox_compliant.description: Whether built binary is 100% compliant with MAS sandbox requirements
